findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Portfólio // Dev Java & Software" above "Eduardo Mota Bielecky da Silva Mello"; "01 // Trajetória" above "Sobre Mim"; "02 // Competências" above "Habilidades Técnicas"; "05 // Conexão" above "Vamos Conversar?"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono, monospace — e.g. "bielecky", ".dev", "Sobre", "Habilidades"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "01", "02", "02", "08"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 22 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Portfólio // Dev Java & Software", "Conectar:", "SP // BRASIL", "01 // Trajetória").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): div#ambient-backdrop.ambient-bg → radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%, rgba(200, 122, 72, 0.12) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 40%), radial-gradient(circle  | div.bridge-ambient-glow → radial-gradient(rgba(200, 122, 72, 0.12) 0%, rgba(200, 122, 72, 0.05) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 80%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 23 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div#about-card.about-text.minimal-card → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 1px 3px 0px | div#skills-linguagens.skill-category.minimal-card → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 1px 3px 0px | button.floating-skill-tag.tag-featured → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 4px 12px 0px, rgba(200, 122, 72, 0.12) 0px 0px 10px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 35 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div#hero-social-links.social-links-hero 607px | div.velocity-marquee-wrapper 1440px | section#sobre.section.about 1440px | div#about-personal-info.personal-info 1010px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 46 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 8 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 16 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 3 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 4, 8 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Terracotta / rust-orange accent (text #c87a48).
findings.fix: Use the accent from the drawn palette.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Todos (8)" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Acessar Projeto" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Acessar Projeto" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Acessar Projeto" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14.4px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 615 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 194 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 47px on the left, 15px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 8 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Sistemas POS & Automação" (0px from the left); "Sistema de Caixa POS" (0px from the left); "Arquitetura Web • Impressão Té" (0px from the left); "Tecnologias-Chave" (0px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 4 screens in a row: "Projetos em Destaque"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it is at 0% opacity).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 976px at 11556px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 8 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Portfólio // Dev Java & Software", "Eduardo Mota", "Bielecky da Silva Mello", "Busco oportunidades como Estagiário ou D"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
